candidate.name: DIRECT_FIXED_WIDTH4_RESOLUTION_SATURATION
candidate.output: all reachable canonical bridge-only clauses of width <=4
candidate.fixed_point_rule: resolve canonical clauses only when the non-tautological resolvent has width <=4; memoize each canonical clause once; continue until queue empty

quotient_operator.canonicalizer: sort literals by variable/sign, deduplicate literals, reject tautologies
quotient_operator.equivalence: two derivation states are merged iff their canonical clause literal sets are identical
quotient_operator.preservation_proof_scope: future resolution behavior depends on clause content, not derivation label/history

positive_control: permuted literal order and independent derivation paths producing the same clause must collapse to one canonical clause without changing consequences
negative_control: distinct non-equivalent clauses must remain distinct; a one-literal/sign change must not collapse

independent_witness.source: immutable exact R10/R11 bridge truth tables
independent_witness.comparison: candidate bridge-clause conjunction versus exact allowed relation

pass_gate: For both frozen worlds, fixed-width-4 saturation derives a bridge-only clause set whose conjunction accepts exactly the immutable 135/127 states, with proof replay and no hidden search.
fail_or_open_gate: If candidate hull is strictly larger, preserve exact false-positive masks and missing width<=4 prime implicates; do not widen, branch, call DPLL, or alter the frozen target.
complexity_claim_scope: For fixed width 4, the universe of canonical clauses over n variables is polynomial O(n^4); this R12 run does not establish a polynomial arbitrary-CNF SAT algorithm unless totality and all end-to-end bounds are separately proved.
